payload.text: Intent 0612 (high, ruled 22 Oct at e248aafd9 on vc's no-objection under hv's pen; intent-dc building): an inbound message moves to the SENDER's board.json, the recipient keeps only handled marks, the inbox view renders from the sender's canon.
